what: tường lan can bãi tắm, a span of the low wall of rough granite blocks between the walk of the sea and the beach of Bãi Trước
uses: Plan 0026, R4: the low wall along the walk of the park and the walk of the sea (data/showcase/bai_truoc.json, walls and beach_wall), one span between two posts.

photos.author: Lam Tr Th
photos.shows: The low wall of the beach along the walk of the park, to the south: rough granite blocks, square posts, a flat top rail, low openings between the posts, the walk of tiles, leaning palms, the beach and Núi Nhỏ.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: Two women who sell food by the low wall of the beach: rough grey granite blocks, square posts, a top rail and an opening between two posts; a woman in a nón lá stands beside the wall; a bicycle.

photos.author: Flickr user 110569822@N04
photos.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the beach, to the north (Núi Lớn with the cable car): the low wall of granite blocks with square posts and openings on the right, a flight of three or four steps down to the sand at the end of a section, a wider stair farther along, swim rings, people on the sand.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with balusters in sections on the sloped stone sea wall, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

checks: Views: front (from the walk), back (from the sand), end, far (30 m).
From the walk the top of the rail is 1.0 m ± 0.12 m high.
One square post at one end; between the posts a low opening under the rail; rough blocks in courses.
On the side of the sand the wall stands on the sea wall of blocks (tuong_bai_tam does not include it).
